newsitem.title: CHINA: Australia insurer cooperates with China's PICC.
newsitem.headline: Australia insurer cooperates with China's PICC.

text.p: Australian insurer Colonial Mutual Group has signed a cooperation agreement with the Shanghai branch of the People's Insurance Corporation of China Life Insurance Co Ltd (PICC Life) to provide assistance.
Under the agreement, the Australian insurer will supply help to the China's biggest life insurer in professional training and management, the Xinhua news agency said on Wednesday.
The agreement was expected to lay a foundation for further cooperation in the future, such as the establishment of a joint-venture insurance company in China, Xinhua said.
Colonial Mutual Group has set up offices in Beijing and Shanghai since 1994.
